facts.fact: The Presidency recalled that article 20 of law 2014-006 on cybercrime, as amended by law 2016-031, sets fines of Ar 2 million to 100 million for insulting officials.
The Presidency said on 8 January 2026 that prosecutions were under way against people, accounts or pages for online insults and hate against senior officials.
The Presidency said on 8 January 2026 that judicial proceedings were under way against people, accounts or pages accused of insulting and inciting hatred against senior state officials online.
